query: I picked up this limited edition space-themed phone case last week that glows in the dark, but I've been abroad for three days and my mobile data won't work at all, even though I tried connecting to the local networks already. I have airplane mode turned on right now, my data toggle is switched off, I already got a notification that I exceeded my monthly data limit, and I never turned roaming on, but I also always keep my network set to prioritize 2G to save battery, so I'm not sure what's causing this issue.
